pages.title: Battery Bank
pages.text: Holds $(bold)4 cells$() (2,000 kJ). Spare network power charges them; when supply falls short, they pay the difference.

pages.title: Cell Dock
pages.text: Holds $(bold)1 cell$() and powers whatever you link to it directly. No Core or relay needed.$(br2)It can't join a bigger network or recharge the cell.

pages.title: Handling
pages.text: Open either empty-handed; shift-click cells in and out. Charge travels with the cell and shows on its bar.$(br2)Breaking the block drops the cells, charge intact.

pages.title: Specs
pages.text: $(li)One Panel Light: about 83 min per cell$(li)RH-5 at 50 kW: 10 s per cell$(li)Comparator reads charge, 0 to 15
